title: State
description: What a log reduces to: fold every entry in seq order and this is what you hold. The console renders it; a log.gap may carry it as a snapshot. The reducer is written by hand on both sides and must agree byte for byte on the golden fixture.

CallStatus.description: Where the call is in its life. idle before any call.* entry, which is what an agent's own log looks like.

UserTurn.description: One finished turn of the caller, with what the session measured about it.

speech_id.description: The id of the reply this turn triggered; the same id the agent's turn and its blocks carry.

item_id.description: The session's id for this message in the chat history.

text.description: The final transcript, or the message as typed.

language.description: The language the recognizer heard, as a BCP 47 tag.

transcript_confidence.description: The recognizer's confidence in the transcript, 0 to 1, when it reports one.

AgentTurn.description: One finished reply of the agent, with what the session measured about it.

speech_id.description: The reply's id, shared with the caller's turn that triggered it and with the llm, tts and eou blocks.

item_id.description: The session's id for this message in the chat history.

text.description: What the agent said. When interrupted, only what was actually played.

interrupted.description: True when the caller cut the reply short.

Turn.description: One turn of either side, told apart by role.

CollectedMetrics.description: Every raw metric block of the call, by kind, in the order it arrived. The turns hold the join; this holds the measurements.

stt.description: Every STT request or stream segment.

vad.description: Every VAD health report that was kept.

realtime.description: Every realtime model response, when a speech-to-speech model runs.

avatar.description: Every avatar report, when an avatar runs.

ToolRun.description: One tool call and, once the app answered, its result.

call_id.description: The id the model's call carried.

arguments.description: The arguments the model chose, as JSON.

speech_id.description: The reply during which the model called it.

status.description: running until tool.result arrives; then done, or failed when it carried an error.

output.description: What the tool returned, as JSON, once done.

summary.description: The app's one-line summary of the output, when it wrote one.

duration_s.description: How long the app's method took, seconds.

seq.description: The seq of the tool.call entry.

PromptBlockState.description: What is known about one block of the prompt without storing its text.

hash.description: sha256 of the block's text, so two states can be compared.

seq.description: The seq of the prompt.changed that set it.

PromptState.description: Every block the app has written, by name, without its text. The history between the static and the dynamic blocks is the turns.

Confirm.description: One confirmation the platform asked for, and how it went.

tool.description: The tool that needed a yes.

call_id.description: The tool call waiting on it.

audience.description: sha256 of tool plus arguments: what the yes is bound to.

phrase.description: What the agent read back to the caller.

said.description: What the caller actually said, once they answered.

reason.description: Why it was declined: no, timeout, changed, cancelled.

Handoff.description: Whether a supervisor holds the line right now.

TransferState.description: The transfer in flight or the one that happened.

status.description: requested until call.transferred reports the outcome.

AttentionState.description: The agent's last ask for a person, from attention.requested until attention.answered settles it.

reason.description: Why a person was wanted, in the app's words.

wait_s.description: How long the caller was to wait.

status.description: open while the caller waits; answered when a supervisor took the line; lapsed when nobody did in time, or the call ended first.

asked_at.description: When it was asked, unix seconds: the entry's own ts.

by.description: Who took the line, once somebody did.

LiveTranscript.description: The words on screen right now: interim transcripts that a finished turn clears.

user.description: What the caller is saying, so far: the recognizer's latest interim, which arrives whole.

agent.description: What the agent is saying, so far: every agent.transcript delta of the reply in flight, joined, since it arrives one word or one token at a time.

Gap.description: A stretch of seqs this reader never saw.

LoggedError.description: An error entry, kept so the console can show what went wrong and when.

seq.description: The seq of the error entry.

Participant.description: One participant in the room right now, as the room reported them when they joined.

identity.description: The identity the room knows them by: sip_+34600123456, agent-AJ_5d2e8f, a visitor id.

name.description: Their display name, when the room carried one.

joined_at.description: When they joined, unix seconds: the ts of their participant.joined.

speaking.description: True while the room reports them speaking, from participant.speaking.

attributes.description: livekit's participant attributes verbatim, sip.* included. The public projection drops them.

Room.description: The LiveKit room the call lives in, and who is in it right now.

name.description: The room's name, as room.opened reported it.

participants.description: Who is in the room now, in the order they joined. A participant.left removes them.

caller.description: The identity of the participant of kind caller, or null before they joined or after they left.

ReceivedEvent.description: One fact that reached the agent from outside the conversation, kept by name and origin. Its data is in the log at that seq.

seq.description: The seq of the event.received entry.

identity.description: The participant that sent it, for source participant.

CustomNote.description: A line the app wrote into the log with call.log.

seq.description: The seq of the custom entry.

name.description: The app's name for the line.

State.description: The whole of what a log says, at the seq it was read to.

seq.description: The last seq folded in. 0 for an empty log.

agent.description: The agent's slug. Empty for an empty log.

call.description: The call id, or null for an agent's own log.

from.description: The calling number or identity, once known.

to.description: The called number or identity, once known.

caller.description: Who is on the line, once known.

room.description: The room the call lives in and who is in it, once room.opened. Null for a text session.

started_at.description: When media came up, unix seconds.

ended_at.description: When the call ended, unix seconds.

end_reason.description: Why it ended, once it did.

user_state.description: What the caller is doing, latest.

agent_state.description: What the agent is doing, latest.

tools.description: Every tool call, in order, with its result once it came.

app_state.description: The app's declared state, as of the last state.changed.

events.description: Every fact that arrived from outside, in order.

tools_visible.description: The tools the model can see right now, by name.

sources.description: The chunks retrieved for the latest turn that used the knowledge base.

held.description: True while the caller is on hold.

muted.description: True while the agent's audio is muted.

transfer.description: The transfer, once one was asked for.

attention.description: The last ask for a person, once the agent made one. Absent from a state folded before it existed.
